newsitem.title: UK: CRT buys Harley-West for 7.96 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: CRT buys Harley-West for 7.96 mln stg.

text.p: British consultancy, recruitment and training services company CRT Group Plc said on Tuesday it had bought Harley-West Associates Ltd, a London-based information technology training company.
CRT said it paid 7.96 million stg for Harley-West, comprising 6.5 million cash and the remainder in CRT ordinary shares issued at 229.6p each.
Harley-West employs 128 people and serves large organisations in the finance and information technology sectors. Sales are expected to total 6.3 million stg in the year to March 31.
